screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Wants are the fun part. Let's talk about them.

screens.title: What a want is

cards.caption: A want is something fun. We're okay without it.
Wanting things is fine. We just can't have them all.

screens.penny: I want a shiny new scarf, {name}. I'm okay without it!

screens.prompt: Put each picture in the right basket.
screens.pennyHint: Fun extra, or something we must have, {name}?
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Would you stay safe and well without it?
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Wants are fun. Needs keep us going.

screens.prompt: You have coins for one treat. Is a treat a want or a need?
screens.pennyHint: A treat is a fun extra, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! A treat is a want. Fun, and we're fine without it.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! We stay healthy without treats. So it's a want.

screens.story: Ling has 6 coins. A kite costs 6 coins. A game costs 6 coins too.
screens.prompt: Ling can pick only one. What should she do?
screens.pennyHint: Both are fun, {name}. This is just a choice.

options.label: Pick the one she'll enjoy most
options.outcome: Ling picks the kite. She flies it in the park all afternoon.

options.label: Buy both of them
options.outcome: Both together cost 12 coins. Ling has 6, so she can't.

options.label: Buy neither and feel glum
options.outcome: Saving is smart. But Ling is allowed a treat sometimes too.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! When we can't have both, we pick what we like most.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! 6 coins buys one kite or one game, not both.

screens.prompt: Is it okay to want things?
screens.pennyHint: One more question, then we're done, {name}!

choices.label: Yes. We just can't have them all

screens.rightMessage: That's right, {name}! Wanting is normal. We choose what matters most.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Wanting things is fine. We just choose carefully.
screens.retryIntro: One last look, {name}. Is wanting okay?

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: Wants are fun extras. Choosing one is part of the fun.
